title: Fix localized contact filter control name in Contact Sync
summary: The Contact Sync page now uses localized table captions consistently in filter operations, replacing hardcoded English table names with the localized ContactTxt constant to ensure the contact filter loads correctly in non-English languages.
key_points: Replaced three hardcoded English 'Contact' table name references with the localized ContactTxt constant
Applied the change to FilterPageBuilder.AddTable, SetView, and GetView methods
Ensures consistent localization with existing field calls on the same page
Prevents contact filter from failing to load in non-English language versions
